claims.claim: Legacy oauth.json with a UTF-8 BOM no longer migrates.
claims.evidence: packages/coding-agent/src/migrations.ts:36 parsed oauth.json with a bare JSON.parse(readFileSync(...)) while settings.json/keybindings.json already used stripBom(); JSON.parse rejects a leading U+FEFF, so the throw was swallowed and nothing migrated.

claims.claim: OAuth credentials, API-key fallback and OAuth precedence are preserved.
claims.evidence: Regression cases 'oauth.json with a UTF-8 BOM migrates its OAuth credentials', 'settings.json apiKeys still migrate when no oauth.json exists' and 'OAuth credentials take precedence over colliding apiKeys' assert the resulting auth.json payloads, not just return codes.

claims.claim: Malformed input must not be destroyed.
claims.evidence: Regression cases 'malformed oauth.json is never destroyed', 'malformed oauth.json keeps the API-key fallback available' and 'malformed settings.json is never rewritten' assert byte-identical files and absence of oauth.json.migrated.
Regression case 'an existing auth.json is left untouched and short-circuits migration' asserts byte-identical auth.json, untouched oauth.json/settings.json and an empty provider list.

validation.notes: Fix is one line in migrateAuthToAuthJson: JSON.parse(stripBom(readFileSync(oauthPath, "utf-8"))), matching the stripBom already used for settings.json, keybindings.json and auth-storage.ts; no other behavior, control flow or file handling changed. The regression is a standalone Node 24 assertion script (node:assert/strict, no dependencies, no network) that loads the real migrations.ts through the read-only .prale-eval/subject.mjs helper with only getAgentDir/stripBom faked and real fs/path, using throwaway agent dirs under .prale-eval/tmp-* that are removed in a finally block. It runs 10 assertion cases: plain oauth.json baseline; BOM oauth.json migration including provider list, credential payload, 0o600 auth.json mode, oauth.json.migrated rename and preserved original bytes; BOM oauth + settings apiKeys side by side; API-key fallback with BOM settings; OAuth precedence over a colliding api key; malformed oauth.json preserved verbatim with no .migrated rename and no auth.json; malformed oauth.json plus working api-key fallback; malformed settings.json preserved verbatim; existing auth.json byte-identical short-circuit; idempotent re-run. Verified locally: exit 0 with 'ok - 10 migration regression cases passed' against the repaired source, and exit 1 with AssertionError 'BOM oauth.json must report migrated providers' (actual [] vs expected ['anthropic','openai-codex']) on an isolated copy of migrations.ts with stripBom removed for oauth.json, i.e. it fails as a real assertion, not a syntax/import/runtime error. Cross-realm VM arrays are normalized with a JSON round-trip before deepEqual because the module evaluates in its own context. Optional validations (biome format check and tsgo typecheck) were not run because node_modules is not installed in this workspace and dependencies must not be installed; the one-line change keeps the existing tab style and stays within the 120-column formatter width.
